messages:
marta: Quick run: FlashFusion phased kernels sweep across A100/H100/L40S, chat-mix (30% system prompts, 70% user+assistant tokens). Seq: 128,256,512,1024,2048,4096. Batch sizes 1,2,4,8,16. Attached quick summary below. Noting weird KV cache thrash at 2048 on H100.

jordan: Thanks — did you see any regressions vs last week's baseline? esp. fused-paged vs paged-flash variants

marta: Yes. On A100 fused-paged edges are fine. On H100 paged-flash shows a 12-18% P95 latency spike at seq=2048, bsz>=4. CPU prefetch thread shows memcpy stalls and queue overflow. Dump below.

alyssa: I profiled the H100 run with perf/top and traced the host-side prefetch thread. pprof flame shows long memcpy stalls waiting for GPU memcpy. Could be pinned memory exhaustion or our memcpy path.

marta: Command used:
```
./bench --model=llama-13b --kernel=flashfusion --cpu-prefetch=on --kv-mode=paged --seq=2048 --bsz=8 --iters=200
```

marta: Quick results (H100, paged-flash):
```
Run: H100 paged-flash seq=2048 bsz=8
p50 latency: 64.3ms
p95 latency: 215.8ms
throughput tok/s: 82k
kernel chosen: paged_flash_v2 (fallback: fused_prefetch)
prefetch queue depth: 128 -> overflow at iter 27
kv-evict churn spikes at 27, 54
```

devon: Could be kernel selector mis-ranking paged_flash ahead of fused_prefetch under high bsz. Suggest rule: if seq>=1024 && bsz>=4 prefer fused_prefetch. Also tune prefetch queue depth threshold.

marta: Agreed. Also KV cache shows small repeated evicts — bumping `kv-cache-window` to 4096 might help for chat-like mixed seq workload.

perf-bot: Auto CSV uploaded: https://internal.redwood/perf/1777777777-ff-sweep.csv :thumbsup:

jordan: Can someone run confirm with `kv-cache-window=4096` + `kernel-hint=fused_prefetch` on H100 seq=2048 bsz=8?

alyssa: On it. Starting confirm run now, will post pprof snippet.

alyssa: Confirm run improved p95 from 215.8ms -> 173.2ms, throughput +9%. Short pprof snippet shows host memcpy stalls reduced, kernel chosen: fused_prefetch_v1.

marta: Nice. If this holds, I'll push a canary change to the kernel selector for the dedicated pool and add an automatic fallback to fused_prefetch when prefetch-queue overflow is detected.

devon: Please file a tiny RFC and add the selector tests to nightly regression harness.

marta: Filed: https://redwood/rfcs/ff-selector-2048. I'll add canary plan and test matrix.

perf-bot: Note: tagging perf/regression for follow-up.

jordan: Thanks team — looks actionable. I'll follow up on the regression dashboard once the canary is up.
